app.name: Synaplan Desktop
app.tagline: Your Synaplan account on this computer

pair.title: Pair this computer
pair.intro: Synaplan Desktop connects this computer to your Synaplan workspace. Open Synaplan in your browser, go to Channels → Desktop, and create a pairing code.
pair.keyHint: For recovery: paste a scoped key you already created. The address is still required.

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: Ask anything. Your messages use your Synaplan account.
chat.skillsActiveHint: Skills can create files on this computer
chat.emptySkills: Ask for a document, a summary, an email draft… enabled skills can create files for you.
chat.placeholderSkills: Ask your assistant to make something…
chat.consentBody: To create files, Synaplan Desktop runs installed skills locally. It only runs reviewed skill scripts — never arbitrary commands.
chat.consentPoint1: Only allowlisted tools (Python, Node, LibreOffice) run — never a shell.
chat.consentPoint2: Files are written only to the out-box folder.
chat.consentPoint3: You can change allowed folders under This computer.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Install and manage Agent Skills that run on this computer. Coming in a later update.
skills.intro: Skills are small tools that can run on this computer. Enable the ones you trust.
skills.mayRunPrograms: May run programs on this computer
skills.installComing: To add a skill, copy its folder (it must contain SKILL.md) into this computer's skills directory. A zip/Git installer is coming soon.
skills.pythonMissing: Some skills run Python scripts, but Python was not found on this computer.

computer.title: This computer
computer.body: Choose which folders skills may read and where files are saved. Coming in a later update.
computer.intro: Choose which folders skills may read. Files that skills create are saved in your out-box.
computer.emptyReadFolders: No folders added yet. Skills can only read folders you add here.

doctor.title: Check this computer
doctor.body: Check that Python, Node, and LibreOffice are available for skills. Coming in a later update.
doctor.intro: These local tools let skills run on this computer. A missing tool only blocks the skills that need it.

status.plaintextWarning: Your key is stored in a plaintext file because no secure store was available. This is not recommended.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_url: Use a valid https address, for example https://web.synaplan.com
errors.invalid_code: This code is wrong or has expired. Create a new one in Synaplan.
errors.feature_disabled: Desktop access is turned off on that Synaplan instance.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unauthorized: This computer was disconnected. Pair it again.
errors.network: Could not reach that Synaplan address. Check the address and your connection.
errors.gateway_disabled: The AI gateway is turned off on this Synaplan instance.
errors.model_unavailable: Choose a model from the list to chat.
errors.not_paired: This computer is not paired yet.
errors.secret_store: Could not use the system secret store.
errors.secret_store_unavailable: No system keyring is available. On headless Linux (including WSL), start Synaplan Desktop with SYNAPLAN_DESKTOP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_KEY=1 to store the key in a local file.
errors.config: Could not save the local configuration.
